environment: local development services with authenticated Playwright and existing real Agent/GenerationTask data
scope: independent Agent shell, compact real task card, Conversation-scoped read-only task inspector, stable nested routes, and legacy workspace regression
checks: Direct /agent access rendered the independent Agent shell without the legacy workspace navigation or the 传统构建 / AI 构建 mode switch.
The Agent shell retained DoodleStory identity, current user, real credit balance, logout, and a low-level /tasks return link.
The blank new-conversation route, historical conversation search, and real conversation restoration remained functional.
The compact task card displayed the real shared GenerationTask ID, title, status, progress, two Panel thumbnails, and current Run state.
The task action opened /agent/{conversation_id}/tasks/{task_id}; no action navigated to the legacy /tasks/{task_id} detail.

The read-only inspector restored after direct navigation and reload, switched between two real Panels client-side, and showed the current real image, story beat, visual goal, and bounded version summary.
Closing the inspector and browser Back both returned to the conversation URL, preserved the draft, preserved a 10px message scroll position, and restored focus to the 查看任务 button.
The inspector close control had an accessible name and the dialog trapped keyboard focus.
An unrelated task URL rendered the real 404 read error with retry and did not fall back to legacy task detail.
The /tasks return link opened the unchanged legacy workspace and its real task list.
A fresh authenticated valid conversation page produced zero console errors and zero warnings.
failure_path_note: The deliberate unrelated-task request produced an expected HTTP 404 browser console entry while the UI rendered its retryable error state; console acceptance was measured on a fresh valid authenticated page.
excluded: Task, Panel, or image-version resource references
Panel writes, regeneration, acceptance, restoration, or task control
VL, Skill, MLflow, SSE, HITL, Memory, TTS, Remotion, or video
